question: According to the census of India 2011, identify the state in which ‘Total Literacy Rate’ and ‘Male Literacy Rate’ both were more than 90%?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mizoram had a high 'Total Literacy Rate' of 91.33% as per the Census of India 2011.
 
• The 'Male Literacy Rate' in Mizoram was an impressive 93.35% according to the same census.
 
• The state has consistently invested in education, leading to significant literacy achievements.
 
• Mizoram's emphasis on educational infrastructure and accessibility has played a crucial role in achieving these literacy rates.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Total Literacy Rate**

 
 
• It is the percentage of people aged seven years and above who can read and write with understanding in any language.
 
• This rate is a crucial indicator of a region's educational development and socio-economic progress.
 
 
 
• **Male Literacy Rate**
 
 
• It refers to the percentage of males aged seven years and above who can read and write with understanding in any language.
 
• This metric helps in understanding the gender disparity in education and its impact on society.
 
 
 
• **Census of India 2011**
 
 
• It was the 15th National Census of India since 1872 and was conducted by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India.
 
• The census provides comprehensive data on various demographic parameters including literacy rates, population distribution, and socio-economic factors.
 
• The data from the census is crucial for planning and policy-making at both national and state levels.
 
 
 
• **Significance of High Literacy Rates**
 
 
• High literacy rates are associated with improved socio-economic conditions, better healthcare, and increased civic participation.
 
• Literate populations are better equipped to utilize technology, contribute to the economy, and participate in governance processes.
